    # ===== FUNCTION: _SqliteDb.run() =====
    # ID: F0348 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/store.py:115-128
    # ROLE: Run several statements in ONE transaction and return what `fetch` asks for from the last statement.
    # INPUTS:
    #   statements: list[(sql, params)], fetch: "none" | "one" | "all" | "rowcount" | "lastid", serialize: bool (unused on SQLite: the lock already serialises).
    # OUTPUT:
    #   Any -> row, rows, rowcount, last inserted id, or None.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0349 _SqliteDb.query() (calls)
    #   <- F0364 Store.submit() (calls)
    #   <- F0369 Store.create_watch() (calls)
    #   <- F0375 Store.execute_recommendation() (calls)
    #   <- F0385 Store.set_consent() (calls)
    #   <- F0387 Store.set_setting() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   (none found)
    def run(self, statements: list[tuple[str, tuple]], fetch: str = "none", serialize: bool = False) -> Any:
        # Lock + connection context manager = exclusive, atomic (commit/rollback).
        with self._lock, self._db:
            result = None
            for sql, params in statements:
                cursor = self._db.execute(sql, params)
                if fetch == "one":
                    result = cursor.fetchone()
                elif fetch == "all":
                    result = cursor.fetchall()
                elif fetch == "rowcount":
                    result = cursor.rowcount
                elif fetch == "lastid":
                    result = cursor.lastrowid
            return result

    # ===== FUNCTION: _PostgresDb.run() =====
    # ID: F0352 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/store.py:147-165
    # ROLE: Same contract as _SqliteDb.run; "?" placeholders become "%s"; "lastid" adds "returning id" to INSERTs;
    #       serialize=True takes the audit/ledger advisory lock 7316003.
    # INPUTS:
    #   statements, fetch, serialize.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   Any.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0353 _PostgresDb.query() (calls)
    #   <- F0364 Store.submit() (calls)
    #   <- F0369 Store.create_watch() (calls)
    #   <- F0375 Store.execute_recommendation() (calls)
    #   <- F0385 Store.set_consent() (calls)
    #   <- F0387 Store.set_setting() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0425 Database.transaction() (calls)
    def run(self, statements: list[tuple[str, tuple]], fetch: str = "none", serialize: bool = False) -> Any:
        with self._pool.connection() as connection, connection.transaction():
            if serialize:
                connection.execute("select pg_advisory_xact_lock(7316003)")
            result = None
            for sql, params in statements:
                sql = sql.replace("?", "%s")
                if fetch == "lastid" and sql.lstrip().lower().startswith("insert"):
                    sql += " returning id"
                cursor = connection.execute(sql, params)
                if fetch == "one":
                    result = cursor.fetchone()
                elif fetch == "all":
                    result = cursor.fetchall()
                elif fetch == "rowcount":
                    result = cursor.rowcount
                elif fetch == "lastid" and cursor.description:
                    result = cursor.fetchone()["id"]
            return result

    # ID: F0358 · method · used

    #   <- F0020 create_app.manager() (calls)

    def audit(self, actor: str, role: str, action: str, details: dict, correlation_id: str | None = None) -> None:
        # Canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) -> reproducible hash.
        body = json.dumps(details, sort_keys=True, default=str, separators=(",", ":"))

        if self._db.dialect == "sqlite":
            # Hold the RLock across "read head" + "insert" (the nested query() calls re-acquire it: re-entrant).
            with self._db._lock:
                prior = self._db.query("select hash from audit order by id desc limit 1", fetch="one")
                # The first entry links to 64 zeros.
                prev = prior["hash"] if prior else "0" * 64
                ts = _now()

    # ROLE: accepted -> executed (only once) and record the sandbox SAP documents of each action (never a production SAP system).

    def execute_recommendation(self, rec_id: int, documents: list[dict], actor: str) -> dict | None:
        """Accepted -> executed, recording the sandbox SAP documents created for each action (atomic, idempotent)."""
        changed = self._db.run(
            [("update recommendation set status='executed' where id=? and status='accepted'", (rec_id,))], fetch="rowcount"

                (doc["doc_number"], doc["doc_type"], rec_id, json.dumps(doc["payload"]), actor, _now(), "created_in_sandbox"),
                fetch="none",
            )
        return self.get_recommendation(rec_id)

    # ID: F0388 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/store.py:409-426
    # ROLE: Acceptance and override statistics of recommendations, with the experts' reason codes.
    # INPUTS:
    #   snapshot_id: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> submitted, decided, accepted, rejected, modified, acceptance_pct, override_pct, reason_codes, override_reasons.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0255 MoatEngine.view() (calls)
    #   <- F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0367 Store.list_recommendations() (calls)
    #   -> F0383 Store.feedback() (calls)
    def decision_stats(self, snapshot_id: str | None = None) -> dict:
        """Acceptance and override (rejection) rates with the reasons experts gave."""
        recs = self.list_recommendations(snapshot_id=snapshot_id)
        decided = [r for r in recs if r["status"] in ("accepted", "executed", "rejected")]
        rejected = [r for r in decided if r["status"] == "rejected"]
        fb = {f["recommendation_id"]: f for f in reversed(self.feedback([r["id"] for r in decided]))}  # latest feedback per recommendation
        modified = [r for r in decided if r["status"] != "rejected" and fb.get(r["id"], {}).get("modified")]
        overridden = rejected + modified
        codes: dict[str, int] = {}
        for r in overridden:
            code = fb.get(r["id"], {}).get("reason_code") or "unspecified"
            codes[code] = codes.get(code, 0) + 1
        return {"submitted": len(recs), "decided": len(decided), "accepted": len(decided) - len(rejected), "rejected": len(rejected), "modified": len(modified),
                "acceptance_pct": round(100 * (len(decided) - len(rejected)) / len(decided), 1) if decided else None,
                "override_pct": round(100 * len(overridden) / len(decided), 1) if decided else None, "reason_codes": codes,
                "override_reasons": [{"recommendation_id": r["id"], "kind": r["kind"], "decision": "modified" if r in modified else "rejected",
                                      "reason_code": fb.get(r["id"], {}).get("reason_code"),
                                      "reason": r.get("decision_comment") or "(no reason given)"} for r in overridden][:10]}

    #   <- F0017 create_app() (calls)

    #   <- F0253 MoatEngine._series() (calls)
    #   <- F0254 MoatEngine.model_comparison() (calls)

    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0401 SapRepository (calls)

    #   -> F0390 TenantContext (references)
    def get(self, tenant_id: str | None = None) -> TenantContext:
        tid = tenant_id or _current.get()
        if tid not in self.files:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown tenant {tid}. Options: {', '.join(sorted(self.files))}")
        # The lock prevents two concurrent requests from building the same tenant twice.
        with self._lock:
            if tid not in self._cache:
                # Dependency chain: SAP data -> engine -> insights / dashboards / role center.
                sap = SapRepository(self.files[tid])
                engine = SupplyChainEngine(sap)
                insights = InsightEngine(engine)
                industry, label, customer = self.labels[tid]
                dashboards = Dashboards(engine, insights, self.store)
                self._cache[tid] = TenantContext(tid, industry, label, customer, sap, engine, insights, dashboards,
                                                 RoleCenter(engine, insights, self.store, dashboards, industry))

    def on_hand(self, plant: str, material: str, *, unrestricted_only: bool = True) -> float:

def ensure_postgres_database(url: str) -> bool:
    """Create the target PostgreSQL database if it does not exist (existing Compose volumes / managed PostgreSQL never
    re-run init scripts). Returns True when it was created."""
    # Local imports: psycopg is only needed for PostgreSQL deployments (SQLite tests never import it).
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit

    import psycopg

    # Split the URL into scheme, netloc (user:pass@host:port), path (/dbname), query, fragment.
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    name = parts.path.lstrip("/")
    # Same server, but connect to the always-present maintenance database "postgres".
    admin = urlunsplit((parts.scheme, parts.netloc, "/postgres", parts.query, ""))
    # autocommit=True: CREATE DATABASE cannot run inside a transaction. `with` closes the connection automatically.
    with psycopg.connect(admin, autocommit=True) as conn:
        # %s = psycopg parameter placeholder: the name is passed safely as data.
        if conn.execute("select 1 from pg_database where datname=%s", (name,)).fetchone():
            return False
        # Identifiers cannot be bound as parameters: psycopg.sql.Identifier quotes the database name safely.
        conn.execute(psycopg.sql.SQL("create database {}").format(psycopg.sql.Identifier(name)))
        return True

    # ===== FUNCTION: Database._script() =====
    # ID: F0428 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/db.py:119-129
    # ROLE: Execute a multi-statement SQL script (used by migrations).
    # INPUTS:
    #   script: str -> the content of a .sql file.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   None.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0429 Database.migrate() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0425 Database.transaction() (calls)
    def _script(self, script: str) -> None:
        if self.dialect == "sqlite":
            with self._lock:
                # executescript runs every ";"-separated statement.
                self._conn.executescript(script)
            return
        # Strip full-line comments first: a ';' inside a comment must not split a statement.
        code = "\n".join(line for line in script.splitlines() if not line.strip().startswith("--"))
        with self._pool.connection() as conn, conn.transaction():
            # Lock 8817000: two API containers starting together cannot run the same migration twice.
            conn.execute("select pg_advisory_xact_lock(8817000)")
            # Split on ";", strip whitespace, filter(None, ...) drops empty strings.
            for statement in filter(None, (s.strip() for s in code.split(";"))):
                conn.execute(statement)

    # ===== FUNCTION: Database.migrate() =====
    # ID: F0429 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/scinsight/db.py:132-145
    # ROLE: Apply, in file-name order, every migration not yet recorded in schema_migrations.
    # INPUTS:
    #   self -> the database.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   list[str] -> versions applied by this call (e.g. ["0001_core", "0002_pgvector.postgres"]).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0112 create_app() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0428 Database._script() (calls)
    #   -> F0421 Database.query() (calls)
    #   -> F0423 Database.execute() (calls)
    #   -> F0416 now_iso() (calls)
    def migrate(self) -> list[str]:
        # Bookkeeping table: one row per applied migration.
        self._script("create table if not exists schema_migrations (version text primary key, applied_at text not null)")
        # Set comprehension of the versions already applied.
        applied = {r["version"] for r in self.query("select version from schema_migrations")}
        done = []
        # sorted(): 0001_... before 0002_...; glob("*.sql") lists the migration files.
        for path in sorted(MIGRATIONS.glob("*.sql")):
            # path.stem = file name without the last extension ("0002_pgvector.postgres").
            version = path.stem
            if version in applied:
                continue
            # PostgreSQL-only migrations (pgvector) are skipped on SQLite.
            if path.stem.endswith(".postgres") and self.dialect != "postgres":
                continue
            self._script(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            self.execute("insert into schema_migrations(version, applied_at) values(?, ?)", (version, now_iso()))
            done.append(version)
        return done

    # Merge: configured keys win over the dev defaults.

    rng = random.Random(20261021)

                      "sap_execution_refs", "human_decisions", "recommendations", "agent_runs", "transport_lanes", "sales_history",
                      "purchase_orders", "supplier_items", "suppliers", "production_orders", "inventory_batches", "bom_components",
                      "materials", "products", "warehouses", "sap_snapshots", "role_assignments", "users", "tenants", "audit_events"):

    upsert("supplier_items", ("tenant_id", "supplier_id", "material_id", "unit_price_eur", "moq", "contract_lead_time_days"), item_rows)

    # ---- purchase orders: open/confirmed + ~60 historical receipts (lead-time history for estimation and ML)
    pos = [
        (t, "PO-4500021001", "SUP-A", "PUMP-DISP-24", 25000, "EA", "FAC-1", "2026-10-15", "2026-11-05", "confirmed", None, None),  # too late for PRD-1001
        (t, "PO-4500021002", "SUP-A", "PUMP-DISP-24", 8000, "EA", "FAC-1", "2026-10-19", "2026-10-24", "open", None, None),       # not confirmed
        (t, "PO-4500021003", "SUP-C", "BTL-GLS-30", 30000, "EA", "FAC-1", "2026-10-10", "2026-10-29", "confirmed", None, None),
        (t, "PO-4500021004", "SUP-F", "TUB-SUN-100", 20000, "EA", "FAC-1", "2026-10-12", "2026-10-28", "confirmed", None, None),
        # the decision used by the outcome-learning scenario: ordered 2026-09-30, promised 5 days, received 9 days later
        (t, "PO-4500020950", "SUP-A", "PUMP-DISP-24", 25000, "EA", "FAC-1", "2026-09-30", "2026-10-05", "received", "2026-10-09", 25000),
    ]
    # True average lead times used to generate the receipt history (SUP-A is slower than its 5-day contract).
    actual_mean = {"SUP-A": 8.6, "SUP-B": 7.4, "SUP-C": 14.5, "SUP-D": 10.8, "SUP-E": 8.3, "SUP-F": 9.6}
    n = 0
    for sid, _, _, approved, items in SUPPLIERS:
        if not approved:
            continue
        for material, _, moq, lead in items:
            # 4 receipts per item for SUP-A/SUP-B (enough for "demonstrated" lead time), 2 for the others.
            for k in range(4 if sid in ("SUP-A", "SUP-B") else 2):
                n += 1
                order = BUSINESS_DATE - timedelta(days=200 - n * 3)
                qty = moq * rng.choice([2, 3, 4, 5, 6])
                # Actual lead = mean +/- 1.6 days noise (+ a small quantity effect for SUP-A, so the ML model has a signal).
                actual = max(1, round(actual_mean[sid] + rng.uniform(-1.6, 1.6) + (0.00004 * qty if sid == "SUP-A" else 0)))
                promised = order + timedelta(days=lead)
                received = order + timedelta(days=actual)
                # Receipts in the future of the snapshot cannot exist yet.
                if received >= BUSINESS_DATE:
                    continue
                short = 0.97 if (sid == "SUP-E" and k == 1) else 1.0  # one partial delivery (incomplete outcome)
                pos.append((t, f"PO-45000{19000 + n}", sid, material, qty, "EA" if material not in ("SER-BASE-VC", "SUN-BASE-50", "CRM-BASE-HY") else "KG",
                            "FAC-1", order.isoformat(), promised.isoformat(), "received", received.isoformat(), round(qty * short)))
    upsert("purchase_orders", ("tenant_id", "po_id", "supplier_id", "material_id", "quantity", "uom", "plant", "order_date", "promised_date",
                               "status", "received_date", "received_quantity"), pos)

    # ---- 90 days of daily sales history per SKU and warehouse (sunscreen + serum follow DEMAND; others random but stable)
    sales = []
    for sku, *_ in PRODUCTS:
        for wh in ("WH-A", "WH-B", "WH-C"):
            # .get(sku, {}).get(wh): planted demand, else a seeded random base 20..160 per day.
            base = DEMAND.get(sku, {}).get(wh) or rng.randint(20, 160)
            for day in range(1, 91):
                weekday = (BUSINESS_DATE - timedelta(days=day)).weekday()
                # Weekly seasonality: Friday (4) and Saturday (5) sell 8% more, other days 3% less.
                season = 1.08 if weekday in (4, 5) else 0.97
                sales.append((t, sku, wh, _d(-day), round(base * season * rng.uniform(0.9, 1.1))))
    upsert("sales_history", ("tenant_id", "sku", "warehouse", "day", "quantity"), sales)
    upsert("transport_lanes", ("tenant_id", "lane_id", "origin", "destination", "mode", "lead_days", "cost_per_unit_eur", "fixed_cost_eur", "capacity_units"),
           [(t, f"LN-{o}-{d}", o, d, mode, lead, cost, fixed, cap) for o, d, mode, lead, cost, fixed, cap in LANES])

    # ---- one prior decision with a verified execution, for the Decision Outcome Learning scenario
    calc = {"kind": "lead_time_estimate", "supplier_id": "SUP-A", "material_id": "PUMP-DISP-24", "predicted_lead_time_days": 5,
            "basis": "contract lead time (baseline v0)", "po_id": "PO-4500020950"}
    upsert("agent_runs", ("id", "tenant_id", "user_id", "kind", "request", "result", "snapshot_id", "created_at"),
           [("CALC-HIST-0001", t, "u-flowise-agent", "lead_time_estimate", json.dumps({"supplier_id": "SUP-A"}), json.dumps(calc), "SAP-SYN-2026-09-30", "2026-09-30T08:00:00+00:00")])
    upsert("recommendations", ("id", "tenant_id", "calculation_id", "domain", "title", "proposed_actions", "evidence", "prediction", "risk_level",
                               "status", "idempotency_key", "model_version", "created_by", "created_at", "updated_at"),
           [("REC-HIST-0001", t, "CALC-HIST-0001", "procurement", "Order 25,000 pumps from Supplier A (predicted 5-day lead time)",
             json.dumps([{"action": "purchase_request", "supplier_id": "SUP-A", "material_id": "PUMP-DISP-24", "quantity": 25000}]),
             json.dumps({"source": "synthetic SAP purchasing history", "snapshot": "SAP-SYN-2026-09-30"}),
             json.dumps({"metric": "lead_time_days", "predicted": 5, "po_id": "PO-4500020950"}), "medium", "executed", "hist-0001", "lead-time-baseline-v0",
             "u-flowise-agent", "2026-09-30T08:00:00+00:00", "2026-09-30T09:30:00+00:00")])
    upsert("human_decisions", ("id", "tenant_id", "recommendation_id", "reviewer_id", "reviewer_roles", "decision", "explanation", "modifications", "created_at"),
           [("HD-HIST-0001", t, "REC-HIST-0001", "u-procurement-manager", json.dumps(["procurement_manager"]), "approve",
             "Supplier A is the qualified primary source; approved.", None, "2026-09-30T09:00:00+00:00")])
    upsert("sap_execution_refs", ("id", "tenant_id", "recommendation_id", "sap_document", "doc_type", "executed_at", "recorded_by", "source"),
           [("SX-HIST-0001", t, "REC-HIST-0001", "PO-4500020950", "purchase_order", "2026-09-30T09:30:00+00:00", "u-sap-executor", "manual_sap_execution_record")])
    # Dict comprehension of row counts for the main tenant (table names are fixed literals).
    return {table: db.one(f"select count(*) as n from {table} where tenant_id=?", (t,))["n"]  # noqa: S608
            for table in ("products", "materials", "inventory_batches", "purchase_orders", "sales_history", "transport_lanes", "suppliers")}

    # ID: F0433 · nested · used

    # ROLE: Insert rows, ignoring those whose primary key already exists (dialect-specific "insert or ignore").

    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0424 Database.executemany() (calls)
    def upsert(table: str, cols: tuple, rows: list[tuple]) -> None:
        # "?,?,?" with one "?" per column ("?" * 3 = "???", joined with commas).
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(cols))
        if db.dialect == "postgres":
            sql = f"insert into {table}({','.join(cols)}) values({placeholders}) on conflict do nothing"  # noqa: S608
        else:
            sql = f"insert or ignore into {table}({','.join(cols)}) values({placeholders})"  # noqa: S608
        db.executemany(sql, rows)

def build(industry: str, customer: str, spec: dict) -> dict:
    rng = random.Random(f"{industry}/{customer}")
    prefix = spec["prefix"]
    cc = {"FR": "+33", "DE": "+49", "PL": "+48", "US": "+1", "CN": "+86", "NL": "+31", "IE": "+353", "CZ": "+420", "ES": "+34", "IT": "+39", "CH": "+41",
          "SG": "+65", "SE": "+46", "MX": "+52", "HU": "+36", "SK": "+421", "TR": "+90", "GB": "+44"}
    plants = []
    for code, name, ptype, country, city, lat, lon in spec["plants"]:
        roles = ["Warehouse manager", "Inventory control lead", "Transport coordinator"] if ptype == "warehouse" else ["Plant manager", "Production planning lead", "Quality lead"]
        plants.append({"code": code, "name": name, "type": ptype, "country": country, "lat": lat, "lon": lon, "city": city, "zone": ZONE[country],
                       "address": f"{city}, {country} (demo address)", "timezone": "local", "operating_hours": "Mon–Fri 06:00–22:00" if ptype != "warehouse" else "Mon–Sat 06:00–22:00",
                       "contacts": [person(rng, spec["domain"], r, cc.get(country, "+00"), i, i == 0) for i, r in enumerate(roles)],
                       "contacts_note": "Fictional demo contacts (reserved .example domain)."})
    dcs = [p["code"] for p in plants if p["type"] == "warehouse"]
    materials = [{"code": c, "description": d, "type": "FG", "uom": u, "unit_cost": cost, "safety_stock": safety} for c, d, u, cost, safety, *_ in spec["fgs"]]
    materials += [{"code": c, "description": d, "type": t, "uom": u, "unit_cost": cost, "safety_stock": safety} for c, d, t, u, cost, safety in spec["components"]]
    comp = {m["code"]: m for m in materials}
    bom, demand, stock, production, sales, shipments = [], {}, [], [], [], []
    expiry_range = spec.get("expiry_days")
    exp = (lambda: iso(rng.randint(*expiry_range))) if expiry_range else (lambda: None)
    for n, (fg, _desc, _uom, _cost, _safety, dem, cover, plant, lines) in enumerate(spec["fgs"]):
        demand[fg] = dem
        for component, qty, scrap in lines:
            bom.append({"plant": plant, "parent": fg, "component": component, "quantity": qty, "scrap_pct": scrap})
        for dc in dcs:
            # Keep the demo readable: only the first product carries the low-cover hotspots from the spec.
            days = cover[dc] if n == 0 else max(cover[dc], 24)
            stock.append({"plant": dc, "material": fg, "batch": f"{fg[3:9]}-{dc}", "quantity": round(dem[dc] * days), "status": "unrestricted", "expiry": exp()})
        run = round(sum(dem.values()) * rng.choice([10, 12, 14, 18]), -1)
        production.append({"order": f"1{prefix}{n:02d}01", "plant": plant, "material": fg, "quantity": run, "finish_date": iso(rng.randint(6, 12)), "status": "released"})
        production.append({"order": f"1{prefix}{n:02d}02", "plant": plant, "material": fg, "quantity": round(run * 1.3, -1), "finish_date": iso(rng.randint(15, 24)), "status": "planned"})
    # component stock at the producing plants: some short on purpose
    for line in bom:
        need = sum(o["quantity"] for o in production if o["material"] == line["parent"] and o["status"] == "released") * line["quantity"]
        if any(s["plant"] == line["plant"] and s["material"] == line["component"] for s in stock):
            continue
        factor = rng.choice([0.45, 0.7, 1.1, 1.4, 1.8])
        unit = comp[line["component"]]["uom"]
        qty = round(need * factor) if unit == "EA" else round(need * factor, 3)
        stock.append({"plant": line["plant"], "material": line["component"], "batch": f"{line['component'][3:9]}-A", "quantity": qty, "status": "unrestricted", "expiry": exp()})
    # suppliers, POs, receipt history
    suppliers, pos, history, lots = [], [], [], []
    profile_delay = {"good": [0, 0, 1], "avg": [0, 3, 6], "poor": [5, 11, 16]}
    for i, (name, country, city, lat, lon, site, mats, lead, otif, secondary, price, freight, oq, profile) in enumerate(spec["suppliers"]):
        code = f"V-{prefix}{i + 1:03d}"
        suppliers.append({"code": code, "name": name, "country": country, "materials": mats, "contract_lead_time_days": lead, "otif_target_pct": otif, "approved": True,
                          "secondary_source": secondary, "unit_price_eur": price, "freight_eur_per_order": freight, "typical_order_qty": oq, "lat": lat, "lon": lon, "city": city,
                          "manufacturing_country": country, "manufacturing_site": site, "zone": ZONE[country]})
        for m in mats:
            plant = next((b["plant"] for b in bom if b["component"] == m), plants[0]["code"])
            need = sum(o["quantity"] for o in production if o["plant"] == plant) * next(b["quantity"] for b in bom if b["component"] == m)
            unit = comp[m]["uom"]
            qty1 = round(need * 0.35) if unit == "EA" else round(need * 0.35, 3)
            pos.append({"po": f"45{prefix}{len(pos) + 1:05d}", "supplier": name, "material": m, "plant": plant, "quantity": qty1, "delivery_date": iso(rng.randint(3, 9)), "status": "confirmed"})
            pos.append({"po": f"45{prefix}{len(pos) + 1:05d}", "supplier": name, "material": m, "plant": plant, "quantity": qty1, "delivery_date": iso(rng.randint(16, 30)),
                        "status": "confirmed" if rng.random() > 0.25 else "unconfirmed"})
            for k, delay in enumerate(profile_delay[profile]):

                                "received_date": (date.fromisoformat(promised) + timedelta(days=delay)).isoformat(), "quantity_ordered": ordered,

    plant = next(b["plant"] for b in bom if b["component"] == m)
    q = round(max(1, next(s["quantity"] for s in stock if s["material"] == m) * 0.15), 3)
    lots.append({"lot": f"QL-{prefix}{len(lots) + 1:04d}", "plant": plant, "material": m, "batch": f"{m[3:9]}-QI", "quantity": q, "supplier": spec["suppliers"][0][0],
                 "status": "inspection", "usage_decision": None, "expected_release": iso(3), "defect": None})
    stock.append({"plant": plant, "material": m, "batch": f"{m[3:9]}-QI", "quantity": q, "status": "quality_inspection", "expiry": exp()})
    # sales orders: one per customer, sized against DC stock so a few are at risk
    fgs = [f[0] for f in spec["fgs"]]
    for i, cust in enumerate(spec["customers"]):
        fg, dc = fgs[i % len(fgs)], dcs[i % len(dcs)]
        on_hand = next(s["quantity"] for s in stock if s["plant"] == dc and s["material"] == fg)
        qty = round(on_hand * (1.25 if i == 0 else rng.choice([0.15, 0.25, 0.35])), -1)  # one order deliberately short
        sales.append({"order": f"SO-{prefix}{7700 + i}", "customer": cust, "warehouse": dc, "material": fg, "quantity": qty, "requested_date": iso(rng.randint(5, 14)),
                      "priority": "high" if i % 3 == 0 else "standard"})
    # lanes between every DC pair (cost/lead by zone)
    lanes = []
    zone_of = {p["code"]: p["zone"] for p in plants}
    for a in dcs:
        for b in dcs:
            if a != b:
                same = zone_of[a] == zone_of[b]
                lanes.append({"from": a, "to": b, "lead_days": rng.choice([2, 3]) if same else rng.choice([9, 14, 21]),

    carriers = ["DHL Freight", "Maersk", "DB Schenker", "Kuehne+Nagel", "DSV Road", "CMA CGM"]
    shipments.append({"shipment": f"SH-{prefix}01", "type": "stock_transfer", "from": dcs[0], "to": dcs[1], "material": fgs[0], "quantity": round(demand[fgs[0]][dcs[1]] * 3, -1),
                      "carrier": carriers[0], "mode": "road", "departed": iso(-3), "eta": iso(1), "status": "in_transit", "delay_days": 2, "delay_reason": "Border congestion"})
    shipments.append({"shipment": f"SH-{prefix}02", "type": "stock_transfer", "from": dcs[0], "to": dcs[-1], "material": fgs[1], "quantity": round(demand[fgs[1]][dcs[-1]] * 4, -1),
                      "carrier": carriers[1], "mode": "sea", "departed": iso(-12), "eta": iso(4), "status": "in_transit", "delay_days": 6, "delay_reason": "Port congestion"})

    shipments.append({"shipment": f"SH-{prefix}03", "type": "inbound", "from": first_sup["code"], "to": next(b["plant"] for b in bom if b["component"] in first_sup["materials"]),
                      "material": first_sup["materials"][0], "quantity": pos[0]["quantity"], "carrier": carriers[2], "mode": "road", "departed": iso(-1), "eta": pos[0]["delivery_date"],
                      "status": "in_transit", "delay_days": 0, "delay_reason": None})
    # stocktake counts + goods movements (one explained, one within tolerance, one to investigate, one matched)
    fg_rows = [s for s in stock if s["material"] in fgs and s["plant"] in dcs]
    a, b, c, d = fg_rows[0], fg_rows[1], fg_rows[2], fg_rows[3]
    counts = [
        {"count_id": f"PI-{prefix}-01", "count_date": iso(-1), "plant": a["plant"], "material": a["material"], "batch": a["batch"], "book_quantity": a["quantity"], "counted_quantity": a["quantity"] - 40, "counter": "Night shift"},
        {"count_id": f"PI-{prefix}-02", "count_date": iso(-1), "plant": b["plant"], "material": b["material"], "batch": b["batch"], "book_quantity": b["quantity"], "counted_quantity": b["quantity"] - max(1, round(b["quantity"] * 0.004)), "counter": "Cycle count A"},
        {"count_id": f"PI-{prefix}-03", "count_date": iso(-1), "plant": c["plant"], "material": c["material"], "batch": c["batch"], "book_quantity": c["quantity"], "counted_quantity": round(c["quantity"] * 0.96), "counter": "Cycle count B"},
        {"count_id": f"PI-{prefix}-04", "count_date": iso(-1), "plant": d["plant"], "material": d["material"], "batch": d["batch"], "book_quantity": d["quantity"], "counted_quantity": d["quantity"], "counter": "Cycle count C"},
    ]
    movements = [{"document": f"49{prefix}0001", "type": "goods_issue", "plant": a["plant"], "material": a["material"], "batch": a["batch"], "quantity": -40, "date": iso(-2),
                  "posted": False, "reference": "Samples issued, posting pending"}]
    snapshot = {"id": f"SAP-{prefix}-2026-10-20T040000Z", "source_system": f"S4HANA-{industry.upper()}-DEMO", "extracted_at": "2026-10-20T04:00:00+00:00",
                "as_of_date": AS_OF.isoformat(), "read_only": True, "modules": ["MM", "PP", "QM", "SD", "PUR", "WM", "LE"],
                "industry": industry, "customer": spec["company"], "synthetic": True}
    quotes = [{"supplier": s, "material": m, "unit_price_eur": p, "freight_eur_per_order": f, "typical_order_qty": q, "quoted_lead_time_days": lt, "qualified": ok,
